courier-relay/protocol-2-contract: Courier Relay protocol 2 is the current provider contract for count and summary requests. Applicability: all receipt sets handled by the local CLI, regardless of receipt dates. When protocol is omitted, use protocol "2"; explicit protocol "2" selects the same behavior, while explicit protocol "1" remains supported with its original contract. Under protocol 2, (account_id, delivery_id) identifies a delivery, so the same delivery_id in different accounts is distinct. Accept exactly one receipt per identity: choose the greatest occurred_at UTC instant, and for equal instants choose the smallest record_id. Accepted receipts retain their original fields, timestamp spelling, and payload and are ordered by original input position; counts are accepted receipts and all remaining receipts as duplicates. The protocol response reports the actual protocol used and preserves the established response shapes. Approval source: issue trial-djn, stating permanent provider adoption and integration-owner approval. Validation: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests; python3 test_public.py --cases public_tests/count_1.json; python3 test_public.py --cases public_tests/summary_1.json; python3 test_public.py --cases public_tests/summary_2.json; focused checks for cross-account identity, UTC offsets, latest selection, equal-time smallest-record_id, empty sets, ping, and unknown command.
